title.en: Units of automatic data processing machines; input or output units, whether or not containing storage units in the same housing

candidates.rationale: A dock is a unit of an ADP system that handles input and output between a laptop and its peripherals, so heading 8471 applies. Of the candidates, 847160 is the nearest 8471 subheading.

evidence.excerpt:
(A)

For the purposes of heading 8471 , the expression 'automatic data-processing machines' means machines, capable of

(1)

storing the processing program or programs and at least the data immediately necessary for the execution of the program;

(2)

being freely programmed in accordance with the requirements of the user;

(3)

performing arithmetical computations specified by the user; and

(4)

executing, without human intervention, a processing program which requires them to modify their execution, by logical decision during the processing run.

title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the reception, conversion and transmission or regeneration of voice, images or other data, including switching and routing apparatus

candidates.rationale: The dock has a network port and data-transfer circuitry, which could place it under apparatus for the transmission or regeneration of data in 8517.62.
candidates.set_aside_reason: Its principal function is ADP peripheral expansion rather than network switching or routing, so 8471 is more specific.

title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the transmission or reception of voice, images or other data (including wired/wireless networks), n.e.c. in item no. 8517.6

candidates.rationale: It is a residual communication apparatus line in heading 8517 that would apply only if the dock were treated as a data-transmission device.
candidates.set_aside_reason: The precedents classify docks and hubs in 8471, not in the 8517 residual line.

title.en: Automatic data processing machines; portable, weighing not more than 10kg, consisting of at least a central processing unit, a keyboard and a display

candidates.rationale: Heading 8471 covers portable ADP machines, but this requires a CPU, keyboard and display in the same unit.

evidence.excerpt:
(A)

For the purposes of heading 8471 , the expression 'automatic data-processing machines' means machines, capable of

(1)

storing the processing program or programs and at least the data immediately necessary for the execution of the program;

(2)

being freely programmed in accordance with the requirements of the user;

(3)

performing arithmetical computations specified by the user; and

(4)

executing, without human intervention, a processing program which requires them to modify their execution, by logical decision during the processing run.

For the purposes of subheading 8471 49 , the term 'systems' means automatic data-processing machines whose units satisfy the conditions laid down in note 6(C) to Chapter 84 and which comprise at least a central processing unit, one input unit (for example, a keyboard or a scanner), and one output unit (for example, a visual display unit or a printer).

candidates.set_aside_reason: The dock has no CPU, keyboard or display, so it is not a complete computer.
